title: The moving stairs
goals: Ask the stair whether it is in place.
starting_code:
# The stair swings into place and away again.
# Wait until it is ready for you to step on.
hints: Walk up to the gap first.
Use a `while` loop to wait as long as the stair is not in place.
Once the stair is in place, walk right to cross the gap.
intro: A moving stair... It swings over the gap, then away again. We should step up to the edge and wait for it to be ready.
outro: That was perfectly timed. Moving stairs are not so scary when you know how to check if they are in place.
learned: Now you know how to wait for a moving stair with `stair.in_place`, and that *osto* can hold it still.
